answer: Rule: every new identity locks a 100 POA stake, and each extra identity funded from the same wallet doubles the stake: 100, 200, 400, so the tenth fake costs 51,200 POA. A falcon-fast audit samples identities each epoch; any relic of past fraud, matching behaviour or a shared funding trail, slashes the whole stake at once. The tide of cheap fakes stops because ten fakes cost 102,300 POA while one honest identity costs 100.
